comments: The submitted URL is the site’s types-of-color-blindness guide and worksheet, which links to the browser simulator at https://colorvisionsimulator.com/. The simulator supports manual design review of images and interface screenshots. It does not diagnose color vision deficiency or certify WCAG conformance.
